title: Real-mode in-flight ApiReturnedBulkInvite response can render the send-shaped toast after entering demo mode
evidence:
scripts/lint_demo_network.py:120-123:
    # Demo bulk invite (2026-08-24 ruling): its only trigger is intercepted
    # AND produces no response — the demo never renders a send-shaped result.
    "ApiReturnedBulkInvite": "UserSubmittedBulkInvite",
Chain: client.gleam:266-267:
    True -> demo_update.handle(model, msg, update_inner)
demo_update.gleam:654:
    _ -> fallback(model, msg)
client.gleam:2252:
    ApiReturnedBulkInvite(result) ->
client.gleam:5884 (enter_demo):
          loading_action: None,
detail: A real-mode send's response landing after /demo entry falls through demo_update's fallback to the real ApiReturnedBulkInvite arm, rendering a send-shaped toast in demo. Pre-existing systemic fall-through; the new lint comment's absolute claim doesn't cover it.
recommended_fix: Intercept ApiReturnedBulkInvite in demo_update.handle (no demo producer exists, so silently consume it), or scope the lint comment/PR claim to "no demo-originated producer". Same window exists for the other two NEVER_PRODUCED entries.
